Nima: Bringing up solarflare-13b (int8 dynamic) — short completions show ZWJ/zero-width joiner artifacts and punctuation splitting. Minimal repro below.

Ava: paste repro please.

Nima: repro:
```bash
python eval.py --model solarflare-13b --quant int8 --prompt "The CEO said:" --seed 99
```
FP16: "The CEO said:"
INT8: "The CEO ‌ said :"
(weird U+200C appearing before 'said' and space before colon)

Jon: hmm. could be tokenizer normalization differences (NFKC/NFKD) or converter inserted a ZERO_WIDTH_JOINER token id. Check tokenizer.normalizer and id map.

Ava: run `python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('solarflare-13b'); print(t.normalize('The CEO said:'))"` and `print(t.convert_ids_to_tokens(60001))` — converter flows sometimes add placeholders at >60000.

bench-bot: perf note: int8 solarflare-13b ~28ms/token, ppl +0.4 vs fp16 on lm-small.

Nima: ran id check: token id 60001 -> '<ZWJ>' inserted by converter. conversion log shows `--insert-zwj-for-compat` was enabled by default.

QA-Micah: high-id special tokens can cause KV-cache aliasing which changes which rotary phase gets applied for later tokens. Run `tools/check_rotary_head_alignment.py --model solarflare-13b --runs fp16,int8 --per-head` and `scripts/vocab_strip.py --remove-zwj`.

Jon: also validate tokenizer normalizer settings; mismatched NFKC will fold NBSP ( ) into regular space or vice versa, which explains the NBSP vs ZWJ behavior. Reconvert with `--preserve-ids --no-zwj-insert` and rerun `scripts/compare_logits.py --fp16 runs/fp16 --int8 runs/int8 --topk 10`.

Nima: re-converting now without ZWJ injection. Filing ticket SF-801 and assigning @Ava @Jon. Will post diffs shortly. :thumbsup:
